description: Send one clinic a question or a call-back request for a person when a booking does not fit: a treatment the clinic books after a consultation, a question the facts do not answer, or "call me". Give clinic_id, the message in the person's words, their name and mobile number or email, and treatment_id when it is about one. A code goes to the person with the clinic's privacy notice; then confirm_with_code sends it to the clinic's inbox. The clinic contacts the person: never promise a time.

callback.description: true: the person asks the clinic to call them back.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

message.description: The question or request in the person's own words.

name.description: The person's full name, as they say it.

phone.description: The person's mobile number. The code goes there; without one, to the email.

preferred_contact.description: How the person wants the answer; a call-back is by phone.

treatment_id.description: The treatment it is about, from search_treatments.

name: send_inquiry

code_sent_to.description: The masked phone or email the code went to.

confirmation_id.description: Pass it to confirm_with_code with the code.

notice.description: The privacy notice the code message carries; the person reads it before the code.

status.description: code_sent: ask the person for the code, then call confirm_with_code.

title: Ask the clinic
